exposure: Maternal disability (pre-existing physiological/psychological chronic health condition)
Accessibility to medical services during pregnancy
Continuous medical supervision or stress contributing complications at birth
outcome: Postpartum depression symptoms (PPD, measured by EPDS)
cohort: A cohort of 421 women who delivered during the COVID-19 lockdown between March and May 2020.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic, maternal disability and Fear of COVID-19 were positively associated with high EPDS scores, while high medical accessibility during pregnancy was found to be a protective factor against PPD.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single time point after delivery for women who delivered between March and May 2020.
